title: avenula bromoides subsp. gervaisii
intro: Avenula bromoides subsp. gervaisii, commonly known as Gervais' oat-grass, is a subspecies of plant belonging to the grass family Poaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, anxiety, and insomnia due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Avenula bromoides subsp. gervaisii include acting as a sedative, anxiolytic, and carminative, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the extent of its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
